scope: Only exact original synthetic source bytes with preregistered opcodes. Literal string and byte-slice conversions and drops have no user callbacks. A freshly constructed Command has no installed pre-exec callback. The reference operation boundary classifies direct API effects; it does not bound behavior executed by an external child, kernel hooks, allocator replacement or arbitrary upstream repository calls.
authority_limit: Explicit accepted research premises, not independently certified Standard-library summaries. These premises condition negative conclusions and remain in their proof and reason references. Installed default summaries remain partial; removing this profile must restore uncertainty for cross-effect negatives. No default promotion or application evidence follows.

operations.rationale: The exact fixture immediately spawns a freshly constructed command without user hooks. This accepted direct primitive boundary records process spawning; filesystem writes performed by the eventual external child are outside it. Other effect families stay conservatively permitted.

The pinned fs::write source creates and writes a File. The exact fixture supplies only built-in literal borrows; user conversion and destructor code cannot introduce a spawn at this direct operation boundary. Other effect families stay conservatively permitted.
The pinned API constructs a command description from a literal borrow; process execution is performed by a later spawning operation. Other effect families stay conservatively permitted.
